Class AnahataUpdateCenterUtils

java.lang.Object
uno.anahata.asi.nb.util.AnahataUpdateCenterUtils
public final class AnahataUpdateCenterUtils extends Object
Utility class for managing the registration and lifecycle of official Anahata NetBeans Update Centers.

Automatically detects the active NetBeans major release version (e.g. 30, 31) across multiple system heuristics (user directory, build number, and product version properties) and registers the official production Update Center catalog (https://asi.anahata.uno/nb/{major}/updates.xml) into the IDE's Autoupdate infrastructure.

Author:
anahata

  • Method Details

    • getNetBeansMajorVersion

      public static String getNetBeansMajorVersion()
      Detects the active NetBeans IDE major version (e.g., "30", "31") using a robust multi-tiered detection strategy.
      1. Checks the NetBeans user directory name (e.g. ~/.netbeans/30).
      2. Checks the netbeans.buildnumber system property (e.g. 30-46c1feab...).
      3. Checks the netbeans.productversion system property (e.g. Apache NetBeans IDE 30).
      Returns:
      The detected major NetBeans version string (e.g. "30"), or null if running in an unrecognized or custom NetBeans Platform/RCP environment.

    • registerDefaultUpdateCenter

      public static void registerDefaultUpdateCenter()
      Registers all standard Anahata Update Centers (Universal, Stable, and Dev Snapshot) in the IDE if not already registered.

      - The Universal Update Center is enabled by default upon initial registration. - The Stable Update Center is enabled by default upon initial registration. - The Dev Snapshot Update Center is registered in a disabled state by default. - If the user has already installed/disabled any of these centers, their enabled state is strictly preserved.

    • bootstrap

      public static void bootstrap()
      Executes the complete startup bootstrap sequence: 1. Auto-registers all 3 Anahata Update Centers (Universal, Stable, Dev). 2. Auto-installs the standalone Update Center plugin if Universal is enabled and plugin is missing. 3. Refreshes active Anahata update catalogs to warm cache.
